💣 BombDefuse

A tense wire-cutting puzzle: a bomb timer is counting down and you must defuse it by cutting the right wires in the right sequence. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Read the defusal instructions carefully — they tell you the correct sequence.
  2. Cut the wires in the exact order specified.
  3. Watch the timer — you have limited time to complete the sequence.
  4. One wrong wire and the bomb detonates.
  5. Some modules may have multiple sub-tasks to complete.
